newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates steady - poll.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave key rates unchanged tomorrow at the start of a new commercial bank reserve period, according to a majority of 10 analysts polled by Reuters.
Only one of the analysts expected a cut in the repo rate this week -- by 15 basis points (bps).
Three of the analysts expected a cut in the draining rate, ranging between 15 and 25 bps.
The repo rate is now 6.50 percent and the draining rate is 6.2 percent.
The following is the result of the poll announced today:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut its repo rate tomorrow?
2. If the answer to question 1. is Yes, by how much will the rate be lowered?
3. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the draining rate this week?
4. If the answer to question 3. is Yes, by how much will the rate be lowered?
5. Is there room for the Bank of Portugal to cut rates further?
